title: fix(app-shell): optional choice rows in Studio metadata forms can be cleared again
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCo1bBWKzRoP44fkJR8d4fe)_

Fixes #29733

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Claim: 6595203212 (amendment 6595600429)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio 元数据表单里「可选」的下拉选项(枚举字段)现在第一项是「— 无 —」,选它即把该键从元数据里删掉(恢复为「未声明」)。必填的下拉、以及列表里的单个元素不变,不出现这一项。另外修了同一条链路上的第二个原因:动作、仪表盘、钩子、页面、报表五个编辑器的「更多字段」区,清空任何一项(选「无」或清空文本框)以前会被宿主的合并立刻还原,现在清空能落到草稿并保存为「无此键」。
- 为什么改:卡片 #29733 指出可选枚举选过一次就回不去「未声明」;对 `user` 字段的 `deleteBehavior` 来说「未声明」本身就是一种生效的语义(不进删除级联)。实测发现 Studio 的字段面板目前根本不显示 `deleteBehavior` 这一行(席位另立卡),但缺陷本身在「更多字段」区可复现(动作的 `openIn` 只能在 self / new-tab 之间选)。
- 风险与回滚:只改界面,不动任何元数据契约;必填项、无值时的占位文字、合并逻辑本身都不变。清空的键以 `undefined` 进入草稿,保存时 JSON 自然省略。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx` 的 `offerUnset` 与两处 Select;`inspectors/fallbackFormPatch.ts`;五个 DefaultInspector 各一行 `onChange`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.optionalEnumUnset-29733.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/fallbackFormPatch-29733.test.tsx`,预期 12 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**1. An optional enum select offers "— None —".** Both builtin select paths of the metadata-admin `SchemaForm` (a form row's `options`, and a schema property's own `enum`) listed only the enum values, so an optional key, once picked, could never return to absent. `FieldControl` now leads an optional row's list with a "— None —" item: the existing `engine.form.none` key (en "— None —", zh "— 无 —"), the word the metadata-admin pickers already use, so no new i18n key. Radix refuses an item whose value is the empty string, so the item carries a sentinel that `onValueChange` maps back to `undefined`, the form's existing clear convention (`setField` deletes the key; a repeater row keeps an `undefined` that serialisation drops). With nothing set, the trigger still shows the "Select…" placeholder and nothing is written on render.

| Row | Before | Now |
|---|---|---|
| optional enum, either path | values only | "— None —" first, then the values |
| required enum (schema `required`, a form row's `required`, a grid column's `required`) | values only | unchanged |
| one element of a scalar list of an enum | values only | unchanged (an element is removed with its own row button) |

**2. Clears in the "More fields" fallback form reach the draft.** The action, dashboard, hook, page and report default inspectors render a fallback `SchemaForm` and wired it `onChange={(next) => onPatch(next)}`. The host's `onPatch` merges the patch over the draft, and `SchemaForm` reports a clear by deleting the key from `next`, so the merge kept the old value: a None pick, an emptied text box or an emptied number box there was undone at once. The new pure helper `fallbackFormPatch(draft, next)` returns `next` plus every key the draft had and `next` dropped, set to `undefined`; the five call sites route through it. `onPatch`'s merge itself is unchanged, and a key the form did not touch is never turned into `undefined`.

## Tests

- `SchemaForm.optionalEnumUnset-29733.test.tsx` (new, 8), over the real `SchemaForm`: the schema-enum path and the form-options path each emit an object without the key after "— None —" (nothing else moves); a repeater card row (the object form's `fields` rows, where `deleteBehavior` sits) serialises without the key; the placeholder still shows and nothing is emitted on render. CONTROLS: a required enum on each path offers no None item; in a grid repeater a required column offers none while an optional one does; a scalar list element offers none.
- `inspectors/fallbackFormPatch-29733.test.tsx` (new, 4): the helper through a merge leaves a cleared key absent and an edited key at its new value; CONTROL: untouched keys pass through and nothing becomes `undefined`; the real `ActionDefaultInspector` under a merging host: "— None —" on `openIn` and an emptied `description` each leave the draft without the key, with the curated keys untouched.
- Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty): A1 `offerUnset` forced false, 4 of 8 red (the three positive pins and the grid optional column), the 4 controls green. A2 the helper's undefined-for-dropped-key line removed, 3 of 4 red, the control green.
- Touched suites, under the verify lock at `--maxWorkers=2`: the 144 ui test files that name `SchemaForm`, one of the five inspectors or `engine.form.none` (`git grep -l`), 1464 tests, all green.

## Acceptance notes

- **The card's named door is not reachable in Studio today (measured).** The Studio object designer's field panel (`ObjectFieldInspector`) offers no Delete Behavior row on a `user` field nor on a `lookup` field; the `deleteBehavior` rows live in `object.form.ts` / `field.form.ts`, which `SchemaForm` renders, and for `object` the editor shows the designer and its inspectors instead. So the named consequence (a cascade or restrict left in force on a `user` field) is prevented here for the moment a form that renders those rows is reached. The missing row in the designer's field panel is filed by the seat as its own finding.
- **Surface:** widened by claim amendment 6595600429 to the five default-inspector `onChange` call sites and one helper, after the live run showed a None item alone would be a dead control there. Clearing a text box or a number box in those fallback forms is fixed by the same change.
- **Defaults:** an enum whose schema carries a `default` is listed in the served schema's `required` and so offers no None item (hook `onError`, `runAs`). That is the existing required signal, not changed here.
- **Not changed:** the action inspector's own curated `variant` select (an `InspectorSelectField`, not `SchemaForm`) still has no unset item; it is outside this card.
- Narrowing declared: the full `packages/app-shell` suite is CI's (Test UI); locally the 144-file grep set above ran.

## Verification

Real backend (`examples/app-crm`, `objectstack dev --fresh`) and the source Console (Vite on `ui/apps/console`), admin session, a scratch package with an object `udb_ticket` (a `user` field `assignee`, a `lookup` field `parent_ticket`) and an action `udb_escalate` (`type: url`, `openIn: self`). Screenshots are in the project folder (`issue-29733/`), not on GitHub.

<details><summary>Before (main 6f094645), the "More fields" Open In select on the action</summary>

- Options read `["self","new-tab"]`: no way back to absent.
- With only the SchemaForm half applied, picking "— None —" left the trigger at `self`: the merging host kept the key.
- The field panel for `assignee` (user) and `parent_ticket` (lookup) shows no Delete Behavior row.

</details>

<details><summary>After, on this branch</summary>

- Options read `["— None —","self","new-tab"]`.
- Pick "— None —": the trigger shows the "Select…" placeholder; Save (draft), reload: still unset; Publish.
- `GET /api/v1/meta/action/udb_escalate` after publish: the item carries no `openIn` (before it read `"openIn":"self"`).

</details>

<details><summary>Local gates</summary>

On head `74e47d1e` (main merged at `25450217`; 11 later main commits touch none of this PR's files): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 35 commands; each ran with exit 0 (`check:type-check-debt` and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` under the verify lock), and `--ran` reconciles 35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. Also exit 0: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`; `eslint` on the 9 touched files (0 errors; the warnings are on untouched lines); `check-partof-closing-keyword`; `check-closing-keyword-parity --body` (binds only this card). The two new test files rerun on this head: 12/12. `dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate (default tier); 520 changed lines before the main merge, under 3000. The repo-wide sweep (`pnpm lint` and the rest of the farm) is CI's.

</details>
